title: Debiasing Large Language Models in Thai Political Stance Detection via Counterfactual Calibration

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating sentiment-stance correlation (Bias-SSC) to detect over-reliance on emotional tone, measuring inter-class prediction variance across different political figures using a recall standard deviation metric (RStd), and testing model robustness using counterfactual data augmentation where political entity names are substituted in prompts.
